influenza virus HA is an important antigen, and the structure of its complex with a neutralizing Fab has been determined.

the structure of HA in complex with a neutralizing Fab has provided a structural basis for the mechanism of neutralization and has also provided a structural basis by which the virus can maintain the conserved receptor-binding region of HA in the face of immune selective pressure for variation.
